purpose: Presents focused dialog content above the current page.

notes: Provider language and direction are applied to the overlay and dialog.

useWhen: A task or decision requires focused interaction without leaving the page.

avoidWhen.situation: The content is brief contextual help anchored to a control.
The information can remain inline without interrupting the user.
avoidWhen.guidance: Keep it in page content or use an inline alert.

supportedInteractions: Open and close with controlled, uncontrolled, or trigger-managed state.
Dismiss by outside interaction or Escape when enabled.
Restore focus to a composed trigger.
approvedPatterns: Compose trigger, header, title, description, close button, content, and footer.
Use Modal Trigger for standard state and focus restoration.
Use controlled state for routing, asynchronous guards, or multiple triggers.
Disable outside and keyboard dismissal for flows requiring an explicit choice.
limitations: Subcomponents and the close button must be used within Modal.
When using Modal Trigger, pass open-state controls to the trigger rather than Modal.
Dialog height is capped and overflow scrolls.
accessibility: Every dialog needs Modal Title, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.
React Aria provides focus management and Escape handling.
Do not remove all dismissal paths unless explicit actions remain.
responsive: The surface is full-width within viewport padding and capped by its selected maximum width.
Dialog height is capped at ninety percent of the dynamic viewport.
rtl: Provider direction is set on the overlay, surface, and dialog.
The built-in close label is localized for Dhivehi.
